method: Write only the packed compact b(y) vector group under a fresh random FP32 address. Read b from fixed or learned FP32 delta state and combine it with the live a(x) branch. The train-only state loss reconstructs b, and each comparison shares a frozen compact teacher and the same held-out episodes. The exact table holds quantized b and the address.
limitations: Fixed supplied addresses and a provided write segmentation. The existing vocabulary decoder generates compact features during encoding. The state reads have no token access. The exact table uses evaluator lookup as a storage reference. Counts include persistent state or table tensor payloads, excluding model parameters, metadata, and activations. Reset and wrong-address rows are empirical intervention controls. No automatic salience, semantic addressing, online parameter learning, or real runtime memory is evaluated.
